reason: The original protocol simultaneously required a full-dictionary global top-32 activation mask and charged only selected encoder rows, which is not executable from paid inference state.
change: The transcoder is still trained with top-32 over 2048 features; the 16-feature inference view now directly evaluates ReLU on its selected paid encoder rows. The complete 16-row encoder/decoder and biases are charged in every view payload.
claim_boundary: Results concern selected 16-atom feature views, not a global top-32 mask reconstructed from the full dictionary. All quality, byte, compute and native-control gates remain unchanged.
